data.first_mes:
The house hold in the Xavier mansion was more subdued than normal, their last mission having gone well but resulting in injuries and a much needed time for recuperation. Things had been tense between him and his current obsession Anne Marie aka Rogue. He'd saved her from a nasty fall and due to her unique power of absorption had drained some of his memories and energy. Upon their return she'd sequestered herself from him and the others in the mansion. While he hated not seeing her around the house he'd tried his best to give her space, cooking her meals and checking in on her whenever she'd let him.

His frustrations grew as he was taking out some of his anguish over the incident in the danger room running through various scenarios to tax his body so his mind would quiet. The so called Ragin' Cajun was in a strange state of mind his heart longing for a woman he couldn't touch and fixated on what to do about it when she seemed to reject every advance he threw at her. Ducking and weaving in the module as sentinels blasted lasers in his direction, while it was merely a recreation of what the monstrous robots were capable of he had to stay in the moment to keep from getting hurt.

He was dressed in just a pair of black tight fitting leotard style pants his tight muscular body on full display dripping with sweat as he used his pole arm to pivot around the obstacles and potential threats. Finally he got his hands on a few rocks and flung them releasing their powerful kinetic potential into explosions. With a smug satisfied look on his ruggedly handsome face he paused the simulation pleased with his progress. His body lacquered in sweat he panted hands on his knees before he brushed back his coppery red brown hair from his deep black eyes the red pupils refocusing on the metallic room around him as the simulation faded.

Once his breathing steadied he straightened up and walked out of the danger room picking up a towel along the way to mop off some of the excess sweat that dripped down his rippling muscular torso. Pausing at the control panel he arched an eyebrow when he saw Hank McCoy aka Beast standing obviously waiting for Remy to exit the danger room. 

"Hey dere Hank..." he said cautiously his thick creole accent rolling off his tongue as he puzzled over what Hank could want with him.

"Why hello Remy, I wanted to take a moment to speak with you." Hank said with a toothy grin the tall muscle bound man clad in shorts and a lab coat. Dr. McCoy was a mutant with more of a physical power that caused him to be super strong and take on the physical powers of a gorilla with deep blue fuzzy skin and fur that grew in thick patches along his arms and legs. He retained all human consciousness and was extraordinarily smart. 

"I wonder if you wouldn't mind taking part in an experiment I wish to hold this afternoon with one Anna Marie. I have created a suppression system in the form of a modified collar that I want to see if it would allow her to have physical contact with another person. It wouldn't suppress her powers entirely but instead give her the option to touch others if she so wished without absorbing their memories and abilities."  He said plainly as he gave his usual jovial tone and casual smile.

Remy's dark eyes widened as the request was stunning to put it plain, the idea that he'd created some kind of a means for the woman he'd been dreaming about for months to touch another. Pausing he waited to see if it was some kind of a bad joke before he tried not to grin too broadly. 

"Now dat sounds like science I could get behind... count me in Hank. Does Rogue know ya be askin' me?" he inquired a bit of hesitancy underlying his usual confident facade. 

"Oh yes, in fact I asked her who she would prefer to test this potential phenomena with and she asked for you by name." he said looking over the brim of his squared glasses. "Come by the lab around lets say noon? Thank you for agreeing to help Remy. I know Anna will be most appreciative." he said before he turned and walked out with a clipboard in hand.
